title: Just Train Twice: upweight what a first model gets wrong
description: Train an ordinary behavior-cloning policy briefly, then find the demonstration steps it still gets wrong and retrain from scratch with those steps upweighted. When a spurious cue explains most of the data, the leftover errors concentrate on the rare examples where cue and goal disagree, so upweighting them pushes the second model toward the true goal without needing labels for which examples are which. Prediction: the policy heads for the spurious cue less often on decorrelated test levels.

source.title: Just Train Twice: improving group robustness without training group information
source.authors: Liu, Haghgoo, Chen, Raghunathan, Koh, Sagawa, Liang, Finn
